description: The plot illustrates Pass@1 Rate (%) as a function of the number of reasoning steps for two methods, shown as two blue-toned lines with different markers. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Reasoning Steps,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 5 to 40 with labeled ticks at 5, 10, 20, and 40. The y-axis is labeled “Pass@1 Rate (%)”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 100 (percent), with evenly spaced tick labels at 20-point intervals (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100). One line is a darker blue solid line with circular markers (labeled “GPT-4o” in the legend); it increases across the x-axis with annotated values of 6.5 at 5 steps, 32.3 at 10 steps, 77.4 at 20 steps, and 83.9 at 40 steps. The second line is a lighter blue solid line with “x” markers (its legend text is obscured); it also increases across the x-axis with annotated values of 19.4 at 5 steps, 38.7 at 10 steps, 87.1 at 20 steps, and 89.2 at 40 steps.
